notes: 7-1/4 in AC/DC circular saw rated 15.0 A at 120 V and 5,800 rpm no load. The parts list is for the 5007NB (MKC) and covers Types 1 to 3; the field, blade case and cord guard numbers differ by type (each claim says which), so check the type on your saw.

gaps: Speed: the catalogue gives 5,800 rpm no load; one retailer listing (not cited) gives 5,000 rpm, so the catalogue figure is used.

Service-change sheet: field 596066-1 (Type 1) / 596396-0 (Type 2), blade case 153436-3 / 142465-1, cord guard 682505-8 / 682574-9. The parts list itself shows Type 2 for the field and cord guard and Type 3 for the blade case.
The armature 510057-8 is listed as including fan 92, an insulation washer, the 608DDW (a Type 2 row) and 6201LLB bearings and dust seal 12, so those bearings are the same pieces as the armature's.
The cord code 2P-14-2.5M is given as printed; wire gauge is not claimed.
No switch rating is claimed: the catalogue's 15.0 A is the tool's rating.
method: Makita General Catalogue 2014, flipbook page 58 (printed page 56) on makita.ca: the 5007NB entry (AC/DC, 5,800 rpm no load, 15.0 A at 120 V); the page was also rendered from Makita's per-page PDF to confirm which card each figure sits on.
Makita parts breakdown 5007NB (MKC), header 06-2011, updated 3/27/23 (makita.ca PDF): parts list on pages 2-3 (page 2 rendered to check the Type column) and the service-change sheet on page 4.
Makita 5007NB owner's manual on makita.ca returned HTTP 404 and was not used; retailer parts diagrams were not read.

comps.spec: Motor of the AC/DC saw; the catalogue lists the tool at 15.0 A at 120 V and 5,800 rpm no load (the amps are the tool's rating, not a motor-only figure)
Armature assembly 115 V, Makita part 510057-8 (no type); the list shows fan 92, an insulation washer, bearing 608DDW (a Type 2 row), bearing 6201LLB and dust seal 12 as included with it
Field assembly 115 V, part 596396-0 (Type 2 in the list, with two ring terminals and two connectors); the service-change sheet gives 596066-1 for Type 1
Carbon brush set CB-154, 2 pieces, part 194986-9 (printed W/ ORIGIN, no type); brush holder cap 643650-4 (2); brush holder 643653-8 (2, included with the motor housing in Types 1, 2 and 3)
Ball bearing 608DDW, part 210005-4; listed inside the armature assembly and marked Type 2 in the parts list
Ball bearing 6201LLB, part 211106-1 (no type); listed inside the armature assembly
Fan 92, part 241513-4 (no type), listed as included with the armature assembly
Blade case complete: part 140H40-5 for Type 3 (listed with O ring 32 and the needle bearing); the service-change sheet gives 153436-3 for Type 1 and 142465-1 for Type 2
Cord with plug printed 2P-14-2.5M SJ, part 664463-0 (no type); strain relief 687124-5 (Type 2 row); cord guard 682574-9 for Type 2, and 682505-8 for Type 1 per the service-change sheet
